marching.line: So comе Lysander, we're on for marching
stanza: So comе Lysander, we're on for marching
Evеryone is true love searching

marching.line: Oh a redcoat troop came marching, marching, marching
stanza: He did not come at the dawning
No, he did not come at the noon

Oh a redcoat troop came marching, marching, marching
King George's men came marching
Up to the old inn door
